KUBECONFIG.description: Path to a credential-adapter-managed kubeconfig with least-privileged access to the intended cluster and namespaces.

distribution.reconciliation: Published as an npm launcher whose per-platform binaries are pinned to the same 0.0.65 through optionalDependencies (linux/darwin/windows x amd64/arm64), so this is platform-neutral without vendoring a binary.

modifiedDescriptions: configuration_view is intentionally omitted from the advertised surface because its native result can expose kubeconfig authentication material.
